en-US.name: Last 30 Days
en-US.summary: Research what people actually say about any topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN and more. Requires Python and the selected source tools; paid APIs, accounts and optional browser sessions need separate setup and authorization.

zh-CN.name: 近 30 天研究
zh-CN.summary: 调研任意话题近 30 天的真实讨论，聚合 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket、GitHub 等来源的热帖与观点。需 Python 与所选信源工具；付费 API、账号和可选浏览器会话须自行配置并授权。

requirements.value: Python 3 and the third-party source CLIs required by the selected research channels. Setup may install additional tools; the operator authorizes installation separately.

Optional X/platform tokens, paid API services and browser-cookie access require the operator's own credentials, entitlements and explicit consent. Declining browser access must leave a cookie-free research path. Any remote API endpoint is operator-configured; missing or failed sources must be reported honestly.
